notes: Conformer populations now use Grimme's quasi-RRHO treatment of low-frequency modes — purely harmonic entropy over-rewards floppy conformers by a factor of two to five in predicted population. Thermochemistry is withheld when the SCF did not converge rather than reported with a warning. The chemistry engine is rebuilt as 0.1.2 and carries every accuracy check added in 0.2.4; Qemica installs it on first run, and Settings → Engines offers the update for an existing environment. Also: charge-transfer advice no longer recommends the functional that triggered it and covers Hartree-Fock excited states, cost estimates understand transition metals, dispersion is no longer offered where the engine refuses it, 6-31G is marked exploratory, and Qemica opens on B3LYP/def2-SVP instead of Hartree-Fock in a minimal basis. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
